About this home

Fully updated and move-in ready! This 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect combination of space, comfort, and modern upgrades. Enjoy an open layout with a large living area and an oversized family room, giving you plenty of space to relax or entertain. The updated kitchen, refreshed bathrooms, new flooring, and fresh paint make this home feel clean and modern throughout. The spacious backyard is perfect for Arizona living, complete with a covered outdoor grill area, ideal for hosting friends and family. This is a must-see home with great value and plenty of space inside and out! ¡Completamente actualizada y lista para mudarse! Esta casa de 4 recámaras y 2 baños ofrece la combinación perfecta de espacio, comodidad y mejoras modernas. Disfruta de un diseño abierto con una amplia sala y un gran cuarto familiar, ideal para relajarse o entretener invitados. La cocina actualizada, los baños renovados, los pisos nuevos y la pintura fresca hacen que esta casa se sienta moderna y lista para habitar. El amplio patio trasero es perfecto para el estilo de vida en Arizona, e incluye un área cubierta con parrilla al aire libre -- ideal para convivencias con familia y amigos. ¡Una propiedad que tienes que ver, con excelente valor y mucho espacio tanto por dentro como por fuera!

About
Corbett
Corbett, located between East 22nd Street and East Broadway Boulevard, is a mid-century and ranch-style Tucson neighborhood with wide lots and desert landscaping. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Park Place Mall area near East Broadway Boulevard and North Wilmot Road, where storefronts, patios, and steady foot traffic set a commercial counterpoint to the quiet residential grid. Brick ranch homes and low-slung mid-century builds sit under mature shade trees, with mountain views opening up along the wider streets. Reid Park’s lawns, ponds, and paths shape daily routines to the west. The Loft Cinema and Trail Dust Town add a distinctly Tucson cultural note beyond the main arterials. Golf at Randolph and a strong bike-and-bus network keep the area connected without changing its laid-back pace.
